title: Brother
html:
• Saṁyutta Nikāya 15.16 Linked Discourses 15.16
  • 2. Dutiyavagga Chapter Two

Bhātusutta Brother

Sāvatthiyaṁ viharati …pe… At Sāvatthī.

“na so, bhikkhave, satto sulabharūpo yo nabhātābhūtapubbo …pe… “It’s not easy to find a sentient being who in all this long time has not previously been your brother. … alaṁ vimuccitun”ti. This is quite enough for you to become disillusioned, dispassionate, and freed regarding all conditions.”

Chaṭṭhaṁ.
